summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the U.S. publication of a patent application covering MDMA and N-acylethanolamines combinations for PTSD, anxiety, and eating disorders. The patent results from its collaboration with NeuroThera Labs Inc., adding to a portfolio of thirteen global applications. The filing also notes FDA guidance on psychedelic drug development finalized July 13, 2026. This is a routine intellectual property and regulatory update, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction, stake, price, or strategic review is involved; the filing merely reports business progress and forward-looking statements.
